title: Tenant 46 Poland: status 841 -> 1892 not configured; developers force it manually
root_cause: Tenant 46 Poland: status 841 (Naprawa wykonana) -> 1892 (Umówiono się (SA)) is NOT configured in Catalog.StatusStep, so the application refuses it; in 3 resolved tickets (2026-04-23 .. 2026-09-18) the work order status was nevertheless changed in Log.WorkOrderJsonLog without an Operation.WorkOrderGpsInfo history row, i.e. most likely forced directly in the database by a developer. CAUTION: in 3 of 3 tickets the change sits within 120 s of another status change on the same work order (looks like a job / trigger / automatic workflow rather than a manual fix).
fix_steps: Confirm in status_step_check that 841 -> 1892 is missing for the tenant (IsRequestedTarget = 0).

Decide with the business whether the transition should be allowed; if yes add the Catalog.StatusStep row (config change), if it is a deliberate restriction explain it to the requester instead of forcing the status.
Check wo_field_changes: a status change without a history row and with UpdateUserId unchanged confirms the manual fix.
If the app refuses for another reason, investigate why the application flow fails (see wo_status_transition_check).
